authority_invariant: No PENTA system manufactures legal, economic, security, licensing, governance, or provider authority. Authority must resolve to CHLOM and the relevant accountable institutional owner.

systems.purpose: Portfolio-level coordination, intent decomposition, governed dispatch, state convergence, and operator control.
systems.authority_boundary: Coordinates only capabilities already granted and certified by CHLOM/provider bindings.

five_stage.discover: Resolve current institutional state and capabilities.
five_stage.govern: Resolve policy and authority before dispatch.
five_stage.execute: Dispatch bounded work to registered systems.
five_stage.preserve: Persist decisions, receipts, versions, and handoff context.

systems.purpose: Machine/tool interoperability and capability invocation across registered PENTA systems.
systems.authority_boundary: Tool discovery or invocation never expands the caller's authority.

five_stage.discover: Enumerate registered tools and exact contracts.
five_stage.govern: Check caller identity, scopes, capability and risk.

systems.purpose: Human and machine institutional knowledge, documentation, evidence projection, versioning and continuity.
systems.human_surface: CrownThrive institutional documentation and knowledge system
systems.authority_boundary: Documentation records truth and policy but does not create deployment or legal authority by itself.

five_stage.govern: Classify authority, audience, sensitivity and current/historical state.
five_stage.verify: Validate links, source lineage, schemas and documentation impact.
five_stage.preserve: Version, archive and retain institutional memory.

systems.purpose: Exact governed routing between intent, provider adapters, runtimes, queues and registered capabilities.
systems.authority_boundary: A route is a path, not permission; exact provider and capability authority must already exist.

five_stage.govern: Check route certification and capability scope.
five_stage.execute: Send work through the certified path.
five_stage.verify: Read back target state and route receipts.
five_stage.preserve: Retain route version, binding and execution evidence.

systems.purpose: Canonical schedules, temporal semantics, clock ownership, recurrence, windows, expirations and scheduler topology.
systems.authority_boundary: Time may trigger consideration of work but does not create authority to execute it.

five_stage.discover: Resolve clocks, schedules, recurrence and drift.
five_stage.govern: Validate timing policy and scheduler ownership.
five_stage.execute: Emit a due-time trigger through a registered route.
five_stage.preserve: Retain schedule versions, changes and execution timestamps.

systems.purpose: Governed event-driven and scheduled workflow orchestration across jobs, queues, dependencies, retries, compensation and convergence.
systems.authority_boundary: Automates already-authorized work; delegates time semantics to PentaTime, routing to PentaRoute, and consequential human gates to PentaHybrid.

five_stage.discover: Resolve trigger, dependencies, workflow state and target capabilities.
five_stage.govern: Resolve CHLOM authority, risk class, human gate and retry/compensation policy.
five_stage.execute: Run the idempotent workflow through registered queues/routes/adapters.
five_stage.verify: Require defined readback/tests/receipts for terminal success.
five_stage.preserve: Persist workflow version, attempt graph, receipts, failures and compensation state.

systems.purpose: Human + AI operating integration, handoff, escalation, approval, override, quorum, separation of duties and accountability.
systems.human_surface: Human review queues, approval surfaces, escalation and handoff console
systems.authority_boundary: Routes decisions to accountable people and records their authority; cannot manufacture a human role, quorum or approval.

five_stage.discover: Resolve decision context, confidence, risk, participants and evidence.
five_stage.govern: Apply human-in/on-the-loop, quorum, conflict and separation-of-duties rules.
five_stage.execute: Create/route the required review, approval, override or hold action.
five_stage.verify: Verify identity, decision state, quorum and signed/recorded disposition.
five_stage.preserve: Retain rationale, evidence package, participants, timestamps and handoff lineage.

systems.purpose: Machine-addressable ThriveAlumni stewardship, councils, committees, appointments, mentoring, succession participation, institutional memory and bounded human governance.
systems.human_surface: ThriveAlumni councils, committees, mentor/apprentice and stewardship surfaces
systems.authority_boundary: ThriveAlumni participation is advisory/stewardship by default; binding authority exists only through an explicit CHLOM-recognized charter, role, term, quorum and capability.

five_stage.discover: Resolve members, roles, terms, charters, conflicts and pending stewardship matters.
five_stage.govern: Apply eligibility, charter, quorum, recusal, term and authority rules.
five_stage.execute: Record advisory/binding dispositions and route valid human governance actions.
five_stage.verify: Verify participants, quorum, conflicts, decision status and evidence.
five_stage.preserve: Retain minutes, dispositions, appointments, handoffs, institutional memory and succession context.

systems.purpose: Institutional research, strategic studies, decision science, scenario planning, foresight, policy analysis, red teaming and evidence synthesis.
systems.human_surface: Research briefs, papers, scenario dashboards and decision memos
systems.authority_boundary: Produces evidence, hypotheses and recommendations; it does not authorize execution and has no affiliation implied with external think tanks.

five_stage.discover: Frame questions and gather source/evidence sets.
five_stage.govern: Apply research ethics, source authority, sensitivity, conflict and publication rules.
five_stage.execute: Run studies, models, scenarios, red teams and synthesis.
five_stage.verify: Challenge assumptions, reproduce methods and score confidence/evidence quality.
five_stage.preserve: Archive briefs, sources, methods, models, findings, revisions and retrospectives.

systems.purpose: Early warning, weak-signal detection, anomaly sensing and strategic watch across internal telemetry and approved external sources.
systems.human_surface: Signal watchlists, alerts, hypothesis queues and trend views
systems.authority_boundary: A signal is an observation/hypothesis, not verified fact or execution authority; source confidence and corroboration must remain visible.

five_stage.govern: Apply source, privacy, sensitivity, confidence and escalation rules.
five_stage.execute: Score/correlate signals and emit bounded alerts/hypotheses.
five_stage.verify: Corroborate signals and measure false-positive/false-negative behavior.
five_stage.preserve: Retain source lineage, signal history, dispositions and model/rule versions.

systems.purpose: Independent evidence sufficiency, policy conformance, test aggregation, red-team checks, release readiness and bounded capability certification.
systems.human_surface: Assurance gates, certification records and release-readiness views
systems.authority_boundary: May certify only against explicit policy/evidence thresholds; the executor cannot self-certify consequential work without required independent/human review.

five_stage.discover: Collect required evidence, tests, policy refs and execution receipts.
five_stage.govern: Resolve certification standard, independence and review requirements.
five_stage.execute: Run/aggregate assurance checks and calculate gate disposition.
five_stage.verify: Re-read evidence, reproduce checks and confirm threshold satisfaction.
five_stage.preserve: Retain certification result, evidence hashes, reviewer identity and standard version.

systems.purpose: Cross-system, cross-repository and cross-provider bindings, trust relationships, events, proofs and federation state.
systems.human_surface: Federation registry, participant and trust/binding views
systems.authority_boundary: Federation preserves participant boundaries and trust claims; it does not create a second universal identity or erase provider controls.

five_stage.discover: Resolve participants, identities, endpoints, capabilities and trust/binding state.
five_stage.govern: Apply federation policy, scopes, trust, data and capability boundaries.
five_stage.execute: Exchange bounded events/claims/work through certified participant adapters.
five_stage.verify: Verify signatures, receipts, readback and participant state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain trust/binding versions, proofs, events and revocation history.

systems.purpose: Governed specification-to-code/config/package generation, test, packaging, release and provider-native deployment production line.
systems.human_surface: Build factory backlog, release and deployment views
systems.authority_boundary: Can produce and deploy only through certified providers/routes and may not bypass code review, security, licensing, human or CHLOM gates.

five_stage.discover: Resolve backlog/specification, target, dependencies and provider capabilities.
five_stage.govern: Resolve IP, security, release, risk and deployment policy.
five_stage.verify: Run tests, canaries, readback and release checks.
five_stage.preserve: Retain source, artifacts, SBOM/metadata, versions, receipts and rollback state.

systems.purpose: Governed media assets, channels, schedules, provider bindings, delivery, maintenance and continuity.
systems.authority_boundary: Media operations remain subject to rights, provider, brand/canon and commercial controls.

five_stage.govern: Resolve rights, schedule, audience, brand and provider policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain assets, schedules, receipts and continuity metadata.

systems.purpose: Governed manuscript, canon, edition, illustration, QA, packaging, monetization, adaptation and publishing lifecycle.
systems.authority_boundary: Publication and adaptation remain subject to rights, canon, editorial and release approvals.

five_stage.govern: Resolve rights, editorial, canon, release and commerce policy.
five_stage.verify: Validate edition integrity, files, metadata and delivery.
five_stage.preserve: Retain masters, versions, evidence and adaptation lineage.

systems.purpose: Seven-generation continuity, succession, stewardship handoff, institutional memory, archive/version inheritance and long-horizon preservation.
systems.authority_boundary: Continuity preserves and transfers only authority that is validly assigned; it cannot manufacture inheritance, ownership or legal rights.

five_stage.discover: Resolve continuity risks, stewards, assets and handoff gaps.
five_stage.govern: Apply succession, access, stewardship, preservation and revocation policy.
five_stage.execute: Create/maintain continuity packages, handoffs and exercises.
five_stage.verify: Test recovery and successor access against evidence.
five_stage.preserve: Retain long-horizon institutional memory and inheritance/version context.

systems.purpose: Governed studio, podcast, recording, livestream and production assets, providers, routes and control surfaces.
systems.authority_boundary: Production execution is bounded by provider, participant consent, rights, brand and release controls.

five_stage.govern: Resolve participant, rights, provider, release and brand requirements.
five_stage.verify: Read back provider state and validate produced media.
five_stage.preserve: Retain masters, project metadata, receipts and continuity bindings.
